name: Shadrix Silverquill
oracle_text:
Flying, double strike
At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may choose two. Each mode must target a different player.
• Target player creates a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying.
• Target player draws a card and loses 1 life.
• Target player puts a +1/+1 counter on each creature they control.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may choose two. Each mode must target a different player.

needs.what: a choose_mode flag for "you may choose N": the mode count is either zero or exactly N (never 1..N-1), answered when the triggered ability goes on the stack so mode-owned player targets can still be declared
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_mode's `count: 2` forces two modes with no way to decline; `up_to: true` drops the floor to nothing and so also allows choosing exactly one mode, which the card forbids (Shadrix's ruling: two modes or none); wrapping the choose_mode in `may` makes it no longer the single top-level choose_mode, so its mode-owned targets (`mode` in target_keys) are refused by the loader. The 'different player' half is already covered: `targeting.legal_target_combos` refuses the same ref filling two target specs, so mode-owned `player` targets on each bullet are pairwise distinct
